name: ui-runtime-click
description: Click Play Mode runtime UI at a screen position or explicit path. Tries uGUI and UI Toolkit at the same bottom-left-origin coordinates used by ui-control-find. Requires Play Mode.

framework.description: Framework scope. all/auto (default) tries uGUI and UI Toolkit; ugui/uitoolkit force one.

x.description: Bottom-left-origin screen x in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

y.description: Bottom-left-origin screen y in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

isNormalized.description: When true, x/y are normalized bottom-left coordinates where 1 is screen width/height.

path.description: uGUI GameObject transform path, UI Toolkit VisualElement path, or visualElementRef (ve:...) from runtime reads/probes.

handler.description: Click dispatch. pointerClick sends pointer enter/down/up/click (uGUI) or pointer events (UI Toolkit). submit sends EventSystem submit (uGUI) or NavigationSubmitEvent (UI Toolkit).
